decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=REPLY, dst=/reply-ep, src=PATH_REF{ index=2, generation=0 }, kind=ERROR, STATUS{ ERROR{ VALUE u16=0x0050 tr::access::denied } } } — what acl/bound-vs-canonical-allow's frame answers when the caller is NOT allowed.
decoded.note: RFC-0024 §6.3, the mandated pair's deny half. The canonical spelling answers the identical outcome tail (kind=ERROR + STATUS{ERROR{0x0050}}, `010001000109400A0008400600010002005000`); the frames differ only in the reply's `src`, which echoes the request's `dst` and is therefore the one thing that cannot agree between two spellings of one address.
